question: Tamil, the official and most prominent language of Tamil Nadu, is a member of ________ language family.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dravidian.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tamil, the official and most prominent language of Tamil Nadu **is a member of the Dravidian language family.**
 
• The **Dravidian language family comprises approximately 80 languages**, predominantly spoken in southern India and Sri Lanka.
 
• Tamil is **one of the classical languages of India** and the oldest surviving Dravidian language, with a rich literary and cultural heritage.
 
• The **notable Dravidian languages** include: Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Tulu

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Munda**

 
 
• **​**The Munda languages belong to the **Austroasiatic language family**, predominantly spoken in eastern and central India, Bangladesh, and Nepal. 
 
• They are spoken by approximately 10 million people, mainly from the Munda ethnic group.
 
• The **notable Munda languages**: Santhali, Mundari, Ho, Korku, Kharia.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Aryan**
 
 
• It is the** language belonging to the Indo-European language** family, spoken predominantly in the Indian subcontinent and surrounding regions.
 
• They are spoken by approximately 800 million people, making them one of the largest language families in the world.
 
• 
 
The **notable Indo-Aryan languages**: Hindi, Bengali, Punjabi, Marathi, Gujarati, Rajasthani, Sindhi, Urdu, Nepali.**​**
